manual_disposition: The deterministic English-oriented length heuristic marked 38 short paragraphs, including equations, tables and Korean mathematical prose. Retained separate formulas, assumptions and proofs for readability; this tool output is not mathematical validation. Independent mathematical review corrected the invariant-subspace theorem to require full W invertibility for uniqueness.
